Do I need a license to run my business here in the USA?

Many new owners do not know that a local license is required to operate. See if you need one, roughly what it costs, and when it is due.

By JK Accounting Group · Miami & Fort Lauderdale

Built with JuliaFounder · speaks your language

Check your business

Two quick questions. Nothing is saved and no email is needed.

Please choose where your business is.

Please choose the closest type.

Takes about a minute.

Your result

Rough first-year cost
$120 – $170
City and county together. The exact fee depends on your business.
Renew every year by
Sept 30
The license runs Oct 1 to Sept 30 each year.
Let us get your license — book a free call → A 20‑minute call. No cost, no pressure.

What to know

In plain words, so nothing is missed.

  • In Florida it is called a Business Tax Receipt. It is the local license that lets you legally operate. Most businesses need one, even small and home-based ones.
  • You often need two — county and city. They are separate offices with separate fees. One does not cover the other. The order matters, and getting the category right sets the price.
  • Some businesses need a state license too. Restaurants, salons, and contractors, for example. The city will not issue your local license until that state license is in hand.
